title: Do I Need a Breast Lift? The Pencil Test and Ptosis Grades
meta_description: How to tell if you need a breast lift: where your nipple sits against the crease, how the pencil test works and its limits, and what ptosis grades mean.
excerpt: Whether you need a breast lift comes down to where your nipple sits against the crease and how you feel about it. How to check at home, what the pencil test can't tell you, what the ptosis grades mean, and how to choose between a lift, implants or a reduction.
quick_answer:
Do I need a breast lift?

It depends on where your nipple sits against the crease under your breast, and how you feel about it. ASPS lists nipples below the crease or pointing down among the signs. The pencil test is only a rough home check, which one surgeon on the ASPS website calls not entirely precise. Your surgeon decides at consultation.
